name: China Lesso Group Holdings Limited
summary: China Lesso Group Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, manufactures piping and building materials in China and internationally. The company provides pipeline systems solutions, such as municipal water supply, municipal drainage, power line communication for municipal engineering, and municipal heating; and water and power supplies, and drainage systems for building and residential.
